welcome_page.title: How you get around
welcome_page.description:
This questionnaire is about the ways you travel. It takes about 4 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#Which way of travelling do you use most: Quale modo di spostarti usi più spesso?
it.#Wheelchair or mobility scooter: Sedia a rotelle o scooter per disabili
it.#Shared bike or e-bike: Bici o bici elettrica in sharing
it.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi o auto con conducente tramite app (ad es. Uber, FreeNow)
it.#Which of these do you use at least once: Quali di questi usi almeno una volta a settimana? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#On foot, even just to reach a stop or s: A piedi, anche solo per raggiungere una fermata o una stazione
it.#Do you combine different ways of travel: Nello stesso spostamento combini modi diversi di viaggiare (ad es. a piedi + bus, bici + treno)?
it.#What difficulties do you have when you: Quali difficoltà incontri quando li combini? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Vehicles too crowded (e.g. no space for: Mezzi troppo affollati (ad es. niente spazio per bici o bagagli)
it.#No bike parking or bikes not allowed on: Mancano parcheggi per bici o le bici non sono ammesse a bordo
it.#Transfers far apart or hard to find: Cambi lontani o difficili da trovare
it.#I feel unsafe (traffic, theft, deserted: Non mi sento al sicuro (traffico, furti, luoghi isolati)
it.#Unreliable information on times and del: Informazioni poco affidabili su orari e ritardi
it.#When this happens, what do you usually: Quando succede, cosa fai di solito?
it.#I travel at a different time: Mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I change route or transfer point: Cambio percorso o punto di cambio
it.#I use only one way of travelling: Uso un solo modo di spostarmi
it.#How often do you use sharing services (: Quanto spesso usi servizi in sharing (bici, monopattini o auto)?
it.#Once a month or less: Una volta al mese o meno
it.#At what times of day do you travel most: In quali momenti della giornata ti sposti più spesso? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#<p>Think about the way of travelling yo: Pensa al modo di spostarti che usi più spesso.
it.#Overall, how satisfied are you with it?: Nel complesso, quanto ne sei soddisfatto/a?
it.#What are you least satisfied with? (Up: Di cosa sei meno soddisfatto/a? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Safety from crime or harassment: Sicurezza rispetto a furti o molestie
it.#When you choose how to travel, what mat: Quando scegli come spostarti, cosa conta di più per te? (Al massimo 3)
it.#What others think of me: Cosa pensano gli altri di me
it.#Which ways of travelling do you combine: Quali modi di spostarti combini? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#<p>This questionnaire is about the ways:
Questo questionario riguarda i modi in cui ti sposti. Richiede circa 4 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.
fr.#Which way of travelling do you use most: Quel mode de déplacement utilisez-vous le plus souvent ?
fr.#Wheelchair or mobility scooter: Fauteuil roulant ou scooter de mobilité
fr.#Shared bike or e-bike: Vélo ou vélo électrique en libre-service
fr.#Public transport (bus, tram, metro, tra: Transports en commun (bus, tram, métro, train)
fr.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi ou service de voiture via application (p. ex. Uber, FreeNow)
fr.#Which of these do you use at least once: Lesquels utilisez-vous au moins une fois par semaine ? (Plusieurs réponses possibles)
fr.#On foot, even just to reach a stop or s: À pied, même seulement pour rejoindre un arrêt ou une gare
fr.#Do you combine different ways of travel: Combinez-vous différents modes de déplacement au cours d’un même trajet (par ex. marche + bus, vélo + train) ?
fr.#What difficulties do you have when you: Quelles difficultés rencontrez-vous lorsque vous les combinez ? (3 au maximum)
fr.#Vehicles too crowded (e.g. no space for: Véhicules trop bondés (par ex. pas de place pour un vélo ou des bagages)
fr.#No bike parking or bikes not allowed on: Pas de stationnement pour vélos ou vélos non admis à bord
fr.#Transfers far apart or hard to find: Correspondances éloignées ou difficiles à trouver
fr.#The trip takes too long: Le trajet prend trop de temps
fr.#I feel unsafe (traffic, theft, deserted: Je ne me sens pas en sécurité (circulation, vols, lieux déserts)
fr.#Unreliable information on times and del: Informations peu fiables sur les horaires et les retards
fr.#When this happens, what do you usually: Quand cela arrive, que faites-vous généralement ?
fr.#I travel at a different time: Je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#I change route or transfer point: Je change d’itinéraire ou de point de correspondance
fr.#I use only one way of travelling: Je n’utilise qu’un seul mode de déplacement
fr.#I make that trip less often: Je fais ce trajet moins souvent
fr.#I avoid that trip if I can: J’évite ce trajet si je le peux
fr.#How often do you use sharing services (: À quelle fréquence utilisez-vous des services de partage (vélo, trottinette électrique ou voiture en libre-service) ?
fr.#Once a month or less: Une fois par mois ou moins
fr.#At what times of day do you travel most: À quels moments de la journée vous déplacez-vous le plus souvent ? (Plusieurs réponses possibles)
fr.#<p>Think about the way of travelling yo: Pensez au mode de déplacement que vous utilisez le plus souvent.
fr.#What are you least satisfied with? (Up: De quoi êtes-vous le moins satisfait/satisfaite ? (3 au maximum)
fr.#Safety from crime or harassment: Sécurité face à la délinquance ou au harcèlement
fr.#When you choose how to travel, what mat: Quand vous choisissez comment vous déplacer, qu'est-ce qui compte le plus pour vous ? (3 au maximum)
fr.#What others think of me: Ce que les autres pensent de moi
fr.#Which ways of travelling do you combine: Quels modes de déplacement combinez-vous ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s'appliquent)
fr.#<p>This questionnaire is about the ways:
Ce questionnaire porte sur vos façons de vous déplacer. Il prend environ 4 minutes.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas liées à votre nom. Elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Ihre Antworten wurden gespeichert. Vielen Dank für Ihre Zeit.
de.#Which way of travelling do you use most: Welches Verkehrsmittel nutzen Sie am häufigsten?
de.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taxi oder App-basierter Fahrdienst (z. B. Uber, FreeNow)
de.#Which of these do you use at least once: Welche davon nutzen Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#On foot, even just to reach a stop or s: Zu Fuß, auch nur bis zu einer Haltestelle oder einem Bahnhof
de.#Do you combine different ways of travel: Kombinieren Sie auf derselben Fahrt verschiedene Fortbewegungsarten (z. B. zu Fuß + Bus, Fahrrad + Zug)?
de.#What difficulties do you have when you: Welche Schwierigkeiten haben Sie beim Kombinieren? (Bis zu 3)
de.#Vehicles too crowded (e.g. no space for: Zu volle Fahrzeuge (z. B. kein Platz für Fahrrad oder Gepäck)
de.#No bike parking or bikes not allowed on: Keine Fahrradabstellplätze oder Fahrräder an Bord nicht erlaubt
de.#Transfers far apart or hard to find: Umsteigepunkte weit auseinander oder schwer zu finden
de.#I feel unsafe (traffic, theft, deserted: Ich fühle mich unsicher (Verkehr, Diebstahl, menschenleere Orte)
de.#Unreliable information on times and del: Unzuverlässige Informationen zu Fahrzeiten und Verspätungen
de.#When this happens, what do you usually: Was tun Sie normalerweise, wenn das passiert?
de.#I travel at a different time: Ich fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#I change route or transfer point: Ich ändere die Route oder den Umsteigepunkt
de.#I avoid that trip if I can: Ich vermeide diese Fahrt, wenn ich kann
de.#How often do you use sharing services (: Wie oft nutzen Sie Sharing-Angebote (Bike-, E-Scooter- oder Carsharing)?
de.#At what times of day do you travel most: Zu welchen Tageszeiten sind Sie am häufigsten unterwegs? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#<p>Think about the way of travelling yo: Denken Sie an die Fortbewegungsart, die Sie am häufigsten nutzen.
de.#Overall, how satisfied are you with it?: Wie zufrieden sind Sie insgesamt damit?
de.#What are you least satisfied with? (Up: Womit sind Sie am wenigsten zufrieden? (Bis zu 3)
de.#When you choose how to travel, what mat: Wenn Sie wählen, wie Sie unterwegs sind, was ist Ihnen am wichtigsten? (Bis zu 3)
de.#Which ways of travelling do you combine: Welche Fortbewegungsarten kombinieren Sie? (Alle zutreffenden auswählen)
de.#<p>This questionnaire is about the ways:
In diesem Fragebogen geht es darum, wie Sie unterwegs sind. Er dauert etwa 4 Minuten.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf verschiedene SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

tr.#Which way of travelling do you use most: En sık hangi ulaşım yolunu kullanıyorsunuz?
tr.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: Taksi veya uygulama tabanlı araç hizmeti (örn. Uber, FreeNow)
tr.#Which of these do you use at least once: Bunlardan hangilerini haftada en az bir kez kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#On foot, even just to reach a stop or s: Yürüyerek, yalnızca bir durağa veya istasyona ulaşmak için bile olsa
tr.#Do you combine different ways of travel: Aynı yolculukta farklı seyahat biçimlerini birleştiriyor musunuz (örn. yürüme + otobüs, bisiklet + tren)?
tr.#What difficulties do you have when you: Bunları birleştirirken hangi zorlukları yaşıyorsunuz? (En fazla 3)
tr.#Vehicles too crowded (e.g. no space for: Araçlar çok kalabalık (örn. bisiklet veya bagaj için yer yok)
tr.#No bike parking or bikes not allowed on: Bisiklet parkı yok veya bisiklet araca alınmıyor
tr.#Transfers far apart or hard to find: Aktarma noktaları birbirinden uzak veya bulması zor
tr.#I feel unsafe (traffic, theft, deserted: Kendimi güvende hissetmiyorum (trafik, hırsızlık, ıssız yerler)
tr.#Unreliable information on times and del: Saatler ve gecikmeler hakkında güvenilir olmayan bilgi
tr.#I use only one way of travelling: Yalnızca tek bir seyahat biçimi kullanırım
tr.#How often do you use sharing services (: Paylaşımlı hizmetleri (bisiklet, e-scooter veya araç paylaşımı) ne sıklıkla kullanıyorsunuz?
tr.#Once a month or less: Ayda bir kez veya daha az
tr.#At what times of day do you travel most: Günün hangi saatlerinde en sık yolculuk ediyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Overall, how satisfied are you with it?: Genel olarak ondan ne kadar memnunsunuz?
tr.#When you choose how to travel, what mat: Nasıl yolculuk edeceğinizi seçerken sizin için en önemli olan nedir? (En fazla 3)
tr.#Which ways of travelling do you combine: Hangi ulaşım biçimlerini bir arada kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#<p>This questionnaire is about the ways:
Bu anket, nasıl yolculuk ettiğinizle ilgilidir. Yaklaşık 4 dakika sürer.

Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. E-posta adresinizden türetilen takma bir kod altında saklanır; böylece farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtlar birlikte analiz edilebilir.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin

fa.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: پاسخ‌های شما ذخیره شد. از وقتی که گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#Which way of travelling do you use most: بیشتر از چه شیوه‌ای برای جابه‌جایی استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Ube: تاکسی یا سرویس خودرو با اپلیکیشن (مثلاً Uber، FreeNow)
fa.#Which of these do you use at least once: کدام‌یک از این‌ها را دست‌کم هفته‌ای یک‌بار استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#On foot, even just to reach a stop or s: پیاده، حتی فقط برای رسیدن به یک ایستگاه
fa.#Do you combine different ways of travel: آیا در یک سفر شیوه‌های مختلف جابه‌جایی را با هم ترکیب می‌کنید (مثلاً پیاده + اتوبوس، دوچرخه + قطار)؟
fa.#What difficulties do you have when you: هنگام ترکیب آن‌ها با چه دشواری‌هایی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Vehicles too crowded (e.g. no space for: وسایل نقلیه بیش‌ازحد شلوغ (مثلاً جایی برای دوچرخه یا بار نیست)
fa.#Long waits or missed connections: انتظارهای طولانی یا از دست دادن اتصال‌ها
fa.#No bike parking or bikes not allowed on: پارکینگ دوچرخه وجود ندارد یا دوچرخه اجازه ورود به وسیله نقلیه را ندارد
fa.#Transfers far apart or hard to find: نقاط تعویض وسیله دور از هم یا دشوار برای پیدا کردن
fa.#I feel unsafe (traffic, theft, deserted: احساس ناامنی می‌کنم (ترافیک، سرقت، مکان‌های خلوت)
fa.#Unreliable information on times and del: اطلاعات غیرقابل‌اعتماد درباره زمان‌بندی و تأخیرها
fa.#When this happens, what do you usually: وقتی این اتفاق می‌افتد، معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#I change route or transfer point: مسیر یا نقطه تعویض وسیله را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I use only one way of travelling: فقط از یک شیوه جابه‌جایی استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#I make that trip less often: آن سفر را کمتر انجام می‌دهم
fa.#I avoid that trip if I can: اگر بتوانم از آن سفر صرف‌نظر می‌کنم
fa.#How often do you use sharing services (: چند وقت یک‌بار از خدمات اشتراکی (دوچرخه، اسکوتر برقی یا خودروی اشتراکی) استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#At what times of day do you travel most: در چه ساعاتی از روز بیشتر جابه‌جا می‌شوید؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#<p>Think about the way of travelling yo: به شیوه جابه‌جایی‌ای فکر کنید که بیش از همه استفاده می‌کنید.
fa.#Overall, how satisfied are you with it?: به‌طور کلی چقدر از آن راضی هستید؟
fa.#What are you least satisfied with? (Up: از چه چیزی کمتر از همه راضی هستید؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Safety from crime or harassment: امنیت در برابر جرم یا آزار
fa.#When you choose how to travel, what mat: وقتی نحوه سفر خود را انتخاب می‌کنید، چه چیزی برای شما مهم‌تر است؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Which ways of travelling do you combine: کدام شیوه‌های سفر را با هم ترکیب می‌کنید؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#<p>This questionnaire is about the ways:
این پرسشنامه درباره شیوه‌های سفر شماست. حدود ۴ دقیقه زمان می‌برد.

مشارکت داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود. پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما به دست می‌آید ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید

hu.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Válaszait elmentettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt ránk.
hu.#Which way of travelling do you use most: Melyik közlekedési módot használja a leggyakrabban?

hu.#Which of these do you use at least once: Ezek közül melyeket használja legalább hetente egyszer? (Több válasz is megjelölhető)
hu.#On foot, even just to reach a stop or s: Gyalog, akár csak egy megállóig vagy állomásig
hu.#Do you combine different ways of travel: Kombinál különböző közlekedési módokat ugyanazon az úton (pl. gyaloglás + busz, kerékpár + vonat)?
hu.#What difficulties do you have when you: Milyen nehézségekbe ütközik, amikor kombinálja őket? (Legfeljebb 3)

hu.#At what times of day do you travel most: A nap mely szakaszaiban közlekedik leggyakrabban? (Több válasz is megjelölhető)
hu.#<p>Think about the way of travelling yo: Gondoljon arra a közlekedési módra, amelyet a leggyakrabban használ.
hu.#Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied: Se nem elégedett, se nem elégedetlen
hu.#Safety from crime or harassment: Biztonság a bűnözéssel vagy zaklatással szemben
